note: BL-507 could NOT be filed via the backlog tool: `backlog create-item` itself throws `foreign key mismatch referencing "node"` against the live backlog.db — Defect 2 below is the tool's own outage. This file preserves the item body for filing after the operator's D step. Priority CRITICAL, repo sox-ecosystem, projectPath libs/data/store/store-adapter.
title: BL-507: ensureFtsIndex turso branch reports ensured without verifying Tantivy backing; Drizzle-era explicit-rowid FK (REFERENCES node(rowid)) breaks every turso write under foreign_keys=ON
body:
C-fix (worktree .worktrees/c-fix-fts, branch fix/c-fts-object, 2026-08-11). TWO independent defects, both root-caused and fixed with red->green tests:

DEFECT 1 (fresh stores, hardening): graph-store applyFtsSchema -> adapter.ensureFtsIndex -> TursoFTSDialect.createIndexDDL emits `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fts_node ON "node" USING fts (...)`; the Turso driver faithfully materialises THREE sqlite_master rows: idx_fts_node (rootpage 0), __turso_internal_fts_dir_idx_fts_node (table, always 0 rows), __turso_internal_fts_dir_idx_fts_node_key (index `USING backing_btree (path, chunk_no, bytes)` holding the Tantivy segments). The _key row is the FIRST row stock SQLite cannot parse -> `malformed database schema (__turso_internal_fts_dir_idx_fts_node_key) - near "USING": syntax error (11)` on EVERY statement through sqlite3 CLI / better-sqlite3. This is the HEALTHY, complete materialisation (verified: identical with and without multiprocess_wal; 3/3 rows; search works) - documented in docs/reporting/memory/findings/bl361-bl362-turso-fts-schema-anatomy.md; BL-329 converts it to ETursoNativeStore for the sqlite adapter. The real code gap: ensureFtsIndexOn returned ensured:true without verifying the 3 rows landed (Turso can report DDL success it did not perform - same caveat as fts-orphan-guard.ts:264-284); a half-materialised index is the BL-361 panic-bomb state that kills the process at the first in-session fts_match. FIX (store-adapter fts-ops.ts): post-create verification of the 3-row materialisation on the turso branch; if incomplete, DROP INDEX + recreate once (measured: DROP removes all 3 rows, CREATE rebuilds them); still incomplete -> typed error, never ensured:true. sqlite FTS5 path untouched.

DEFECT 2 (live/legacy stores, the production outage): the live backlog.db (and every Drizzle-era store) carries `src INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES node(rowid) ON DELETE CASCADE` - an explicit-rowid FK. With PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON (graph-store applySchema sets it), turso/libSQL cannot resolve the explicit rowid alias: EVERY statement dies with `Runtime error: foreign key mismatch referencing "node"` (reproduced on a copy of the live store; the backlog CLI itself throws it today - create-item is down). Stock SQLite resolves the form fine (rowid = INTEGER PRIMARY KEY alias); implicit `REFERENCES node` and explicit `REFERENCES node(uid)` both work on turso - measured. FIX (graph-store index.ts ensureCheckConstraints): detect the explicit-rowid FK on edge and rebuild edge via the existing rebuildTable machinery with EDGE_TABLE_DDL (implicit form) - gated on adapter.config.type === 'turso' (sqlite keeps byte-identical identity, BL-448 AC-3; exception added to tools/eslint-local/no-storage-backend-leak.cjs with citation).

Attribution hypothesis adjudication: (a) graph-store emits the Tantivy path for turso - CONFIRMED; (b) adapter exec() silently no-ops DDL causing a torn index - REFUTED (exec forwards verbatim; materialisation is complete; the no-op only affects DROPs of fts5/vec0 objects, BUG-TURSO-ADAPTER-EXEC-DDL-SILENT-NOOP-001, unrelated to creation); (c) turso never fires fts5 trigger bodies - TRUE but irrelevant (turso branch never installs the fts5 triggers; the live store carries them as RESIDUE from the sqlite era); (d) multiprocessWal default causes the object - REFUTED (identical materialisation with flag on/off).

Malformed object vs FK mismatch: INDEPENDENT defects. The malformed object fires on fresh stores (healthy, breaks only stock-SQLite tooling); the FK mismatch fires on live/legacy stores (Drizzle-era DDL, breaks turso writes). The live store carries BOTH.

Release path: BOTH packages changed - store-adapter (fts-ops.ts) AND graph-store (index.ts). Republish both; adhd (pinned ^0.5.1/^0.8.1) relock/reinstall both.

Regression tests (BL-225, real engines, red->green run): store-adapter fts-ensure-turso-backing.bl507.spec.ts (RED: current code leaves _key missing and reports ensured; GREEN: repaired 3/3); graph-store open-explicit-rowid-fk.bl507.spec.ts (RED: turso writeNode dies with foreign key mismatch referencing node; GREEN: edge rebuilt at open, writes succeed, DDL normalized); graph-store fresh-store-backlog-open-path.bl507.spec.ts (both engines: writeNode/writeEdge/searchNodes work; turso internal set is exactly the healthy 3-row materialisation; stock-SQLite failure on a backupTo copy pinned as the documented BL-329 error).
